start.text: The shift is over. The attacks had one thing in common: text that was taken for an order.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. The lesson: check what comes in, keep the software up to date, and lock the admin door.
A.name: Carla

B.text: Some of the new cards have [b][color=green]Exploit[/color][/b]. Point at the word to read it. They hit much harder when the threat is Exposed.
B.name: Carla

C.text: So I expose it first, then it hurts. And I buy the upgrade my clues point at.
C.name: Joshua

D.text: Exactly. Use your Security Points, and read what your clues recommended.
D.name: Carla

E.text: Understood. Check the input, patch the framework, and lock the admin door.
E.name: Joshua
